alt: No 2014 model year was sold in the US.

issues.sym: A burning smell, smoke or melting near the driver door switch, or the switch stops working.
issues.why: Water can get past the switch cover into the master power window switch and make it overheat. Honda recalled these years and later recalled them again because the first fix was not enough.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If you see smoke or smell burning from the door, stop and get out, and have the switch replaced.

issues.sym: One or both low beams go out or flicker.
issues.why: The low-beam wiring connector can wear from tension on the harness. Honda recalled these years.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the connector repaired. Avoid night driving without working low beams.

issues.sym: The airbag warning light or passenger airbag indicator behaves oddly.
issues.why: Wiring for the passenger detection system runs under the driver's carpet and can corrode from road salt, so the system may not turn off the passenger airbag for a small or out-of-position passenger. Honda recalled these years.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. Keep children in the back seat until it is fixed.

issues.sym: A clunk or grinding from the front wheels, then sudden loss of drive.
issues.why: The protective coating on the driveshafts may have been applied poorly, so road salt can rust them until they break. Honda recalled these years.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the driveshafts inspected or replaced, especially in salt-belt states.

issues.sym: Warm air from the vents, sometimes with grinding or rattling when the A/C runs.
issues.why: The A/C compressor or its clutch can fail, and some cars lose refrigerant first and need a recharge.
issues.next: Have the A/C tested for leaks and compressor operation before simply adding refrigerant.

issues.sym: Check engine light, misfire codes, shaking at idle and hesitation when accelerating.
issues.why: Ignition coil packs are the most reported repair on the Fit. When one fails, its cylinder stops firing properly. Honda issued a service bulletin on misfires for the third generation.
issues.next: Have the misfire code read and the failed coil replaced. Do not drive long with a flashing check engine light.

issues.t: VTEC valve spring failure can stall the engine
issues.sym: Rough running, misfire, a ticking noise from the top of the engine, or the engine stalling.
issues.why: One or more springs in the VTEC valve system may fail. Honda recalled these years.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the springs replaced. Do not keep driving if the engine runs rough or stalls.

issues.t: Stability control may not hold the car in hard maneuvers
issues.sym: Usually nothing noticeable in normal driving. The car may slide more than expected in a sudden swerve.
issues.why: With certain tires, the stability control settings could allow too much yaw at large steering angles. Honda recalled these years for a software update.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the update done.

issues.sym: A clunk, then the car will not move under power.
issues.why: Some right-side driveshafts on manual-transmission cars were not heat treated correctly and can break. Honda recalled these cars.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the driveshaft replaced.

issues.t: CVT drive pulley shaft can break
issues.sym: Hesitation, a shudder or loss of acceleration. In the worst case the car loses drive or the front wheels lock up.
issues.why: Transmission software settings put too much stress on the CVT drive pulley shaft. Honda recalled these cars to update the software and inspect the shaft.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and get the software update and inspection. Have the car checked promptly if it loses power.

issues.t: Ignition coil wiring can overheat and stall the engine
issues.sym: Check engine light, misfire or the engine stalling while driving.
issues.why: Damaged wiring to an ignition coil noise suppressor can make the coil overheat. Honda recalled these cars.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the coil wiring repaired.

issues.t: Loud rattle for a few seconds at cold start
issues.sym: A loud rattle from the engine for one to three seconds right after starting cold.
issues.why: The variable valve timing actuator's lock pin does not always hold when the engine is off. Honda issued a service bulletin to replace the actuator.
issues.next: Ask a Honda dealer about service bulletin A16-088 and have the actuator replaced if the noise matches.

issues.sym: Check engine light, misfire codes and rough running, especially after many short trips.
issues.why: On this direct-injection engine, fuel never washes the intake valves, so carbon builds up on them. Honda issued a service bulletin for cleaning the intake ports.
issues.next: Have a Honda dealer diagnose the misfire and ask about intake port cleaning under bulletin 21-007.

issues.sym: The 7-inch screen freezes or reboots, the rear camera or LaneWatch view drops out, or the radio cuts out.
issues.why: Software faults in the early display audio unit. Honda issued technical bulletins on intermittent screen, camera and audio malfunctions.
issues.next: Ask a Honda dealer for the latest display audio software. Some units need replacement.

issues.t: Side curtain airbag may be punctured by a bracket
issues.why: On certain LX models without a sunroof, the rear grab handle brackets could puncture the side curtain airbags when they deploy. Honda recalled these cars.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the brackets fixed.

issues.sym: Rough running, stalling while driving, or the engine not starting.
issues.why: The low-pressure fuel pump inside the tank can fail. These years are covered by fuel pump recalls.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and get the free pump replacement before relying on the car.

issues.t: Backup camera image may not appear
issues.sym: The rearview camera picture does not show when shifting into reverse.
issues.why: A software issue can keep the rearview image from displaying when the car is started with a key. Honda recalled these years, then issued a follow-up recall.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. Look over your shoulder when backing up until it is fixed.

issues.sym: The airbag warning light comes on or the passenger airbag status light acts oddly.
issues.why: The front passenger seat weight sensor can crack and short out, so the passenger airbag may not switch off for a child or could deploy when it should not. Honda recalled these years.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the sensor replaced. Keep children in the back seat.
